bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-public-sync-1d97db6"
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
old="$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
next="$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 1d97db6d00e47d92ca769e541b5dfe3f1299dee4 || exit 70
test "$(sha256sum "$old" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 57ec0f1ae8df1123a11781b038ef4d2214a4fac75632c5e95c4854c31b1c5cc1 || exit 71
test "$(sha256sum "$next" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = b9be31cf75231f38eb762563b8fcb0cb2399ebecf65dfedf303037a3d3582ad1 || exit 72
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 73
before_userbot=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 74
before_pg=$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
before_img=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
test "$before_img" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 75
docker compose -p deploy -f "$next" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 76
rollback() {
 echo ROOM_DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_TRIGGERED
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$old" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || :
}
trap rollback ERR
docker compose -p deploy -f "$next" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs
for i in $(seq 1 24); do
 test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || { sleep 1; continue; }
 if docker logs --since 3m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then break; fi
 sleep 1
done
docker logs --since 3m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 77
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_EVENT_WORKER_ENABLED" = enabled && test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED" = enabled' || exit 78
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$before_img" || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0 || exit 80
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$before_pg" || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)" = "$before_userbot" || exit 82
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 83
trap - ERR
echo ROOM_SYNC_FLAGS_PRODUCTION_PASS
echo GAYBBS_READY_PASS
echo PG_UNCHANGED_PASS
echo USERBOT_PID_UNCHANGED_PASS
echo GAYBBS_ONLY_RECREATED_PASS
